 select count(1) into chk_count from valid_interdictions

declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('18025',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;

/*
This procedure will be used to check the duplicate records - 
The program will prevent enteries if the source value, target value, target code type are the same 
*/
PROCEDURE DUP_RECORD_CHECK IS


counter number(10);
rec_num number(10);
--variables to store values in
v_source_value varchar2(50);
v_target_value varchar2(50);
v_target_code_type varchar2(50);
v_source_code_type varchar2(50);
v_source_id varchar2(50);
v_target_id varchar2(50);

v_no_of_rec number(10);
curr_rec number(10);
BEGIN
 if :IDP_CONV_REF_VALUES.source_code_type is not null and
 :IDP_CONV_REF_VALUES.source_value is not null and
 :IDP_CONV_REF_VALUES.target_value is not null and 
 :IDP_CONV_REF_VALUES.target_code_type is not null then
 go_block('IDP_CONV_REF_VALUES');
 last_record;
 v_no_of_rec := :system.cursor_record; --track # of records in the block for loop
 first_record;--return to first rec
 for i in 1 .. v_no_of_rec loop 
 curr_rec := :system.cursor_record; --track which rec we left off at

 v_source_id := :ctrl_blk_1.source_id;
 v_target_id := :ctrl_blk_1.target_id;
 v_source_code_type := :IDP_CONV_REF_VALUES.source_code_type;
 v_source_value := :IDP_CONV_REF_VALUES.source_value;
 v_target_value := :IDP_CONV_REF_VALUES.target_value;
 v_target_code_type := :IDP_CONV_REF_VALUES.target_code_type;
 
 first_record;--to compare thru the whole block for dups
 counter := 0;
 loop 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.source_id = v_source_id and
 :ctrl_blk_1.target_id = v_target_id and
 :IDP_CONV_REF_VALUES.source_code_type = v_source_code_type and
 :IDP_CONV_REF_VALUES.source_value = v_source_value and
 :IDP_CONV_REF_VALUES.target_value = v_target_value and
 :IDP_CONV_REF_VALUES.target_code_type = v_target_code_type then

 counter := counter + 1;
 end if;
 exit when :system.cursor_record = v_no_of_rec;
 next_record;
 end loop; 
 if counter > 1 then 
 BELL;
 go_record(curr_rec);
 show_error('0319'); 
 end if;

 go_record(curr_rec+1); --back to the rec we left off at + 1- sort of next record 

 end loop;

 first_record;
 else
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;

end;
